notes: Least subset containing X and every constant and closed under every function; empty when there are no constants and X is empty.

role: finite set of atomic formulas on n slots
notes: Built from the variables x_0..x_{n-1} and the constant symbols of a finite signature without function symbols. Distinct from the P9 Kamp atomic-component operator.
Set of members of At_n true at the tuple.

role: pattern formula of a set of atomic formulas
notes: Conjunction of the members of Delta and the negations of the other members of At_n. Subscript is a set of formulas, not an index or projection.

role: set of patterns realized by n-tuples of a structure
notes: Finite, of size at most 2 to the power |At_n|.

role: graph axioms together with all extension axioms
notes: The theory of def:p03-fraisse54-graph-axioms; complete with quantifier elimination.
Equivalence relation on the slots and a simple graph on its classes; the formula fixes equalities and adjacency between distinct classes.

role: set of graph patterns on n slots
notes: Size is the sum over k of Stirling numbers of the second kind times 2^{k(k-1)/2}.

role: computed finite set of satisfying graph patterns
notes: The ordered list contains all free variables; atomic selection, complement, intersection and existential projection define the computation. Not a probability measure.

role: restriction of a graph pattern to its first n slots
notes: Restricts the equality partition and induced graph; used to eliminate the final variable slot.
